entries.title: Job 19:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 19:2
segments: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

entries.title: Job 19:3
segments: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed [that] ye make yourselves strange to me. {make...: or, harden yourselves against me}

words.text: to me. {make...: or, harden yourselves against me}

entries.title: Job 19:4
segments: And be it indeed [that] I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

entries.title: Job 19:5
segments: If indeed ye will magnify [yourselves] against me, and plead against me my reproach:

entries.title: Job 19:6
segments: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

entries.title: Job 19:7
segments: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but [there is] no judgment. {wrong: or, violence}

entries.title: Job 19:8
segments: ¶He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

entries.title: Job 19:9
segments: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown [from] my head.

entries.title: Job 19:10
segments: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

entries.title: Job 19:11
segments: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as [one of] his enemies.

words.text: me unto him as [one of] his enemies

entries.title: Job 19:12
segments: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

entries.title: Job 19:13
segments: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

entries.title: Job 19:14
segments: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

entries.title: Job 19:15
segments: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

entries.title: Job 19:16
segments: I called my servant, and he gave [me] no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

entries.title: Job 19:17
segments: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's [sake] of mine own body. {mine...: Heb. my belly}

entries.title: Job 19:18
segments: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me. {young...: or, the wicked}

entries.title: Job 19:19
segments: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me. {my...: Heb. the men of my secret}

words.text: me: and they whom I loved
against me. {my...: Heb. the men of my secret}

entries.title: Job 19:20
segments: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth. {and to: or, as to}

entries.title: Job 19:21
segments: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

words.text: upon me, O ye my friends

entries.title: Job 19:22
segments: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

entries.title: Job 19:23
segments: ¶Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book! {Oh...: Heb. Who will give, etc}

entries.title: Job 19:24
segments: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

entries.title: Job 19:25
segments: For I know [that] my redeemer liveth, and [that] he shall stand at the latter [day] upon the earth:

entries.title: Job 19:26
segments: And [though] after my skin [worms] destroy this [body], yet in my flesh shall I see God: {And...: or, After I shall awake, though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh}

words.text: : {And...: or, After I shall awake, though this body be destroyed, yet out of my flesh}

entries.title: Job 19:27
segments: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; [though] my reins be consumed within me. {another: Heb. a stranger} {though...: or, my reins within me are consumed with earnest desire (for that day)} {within...: Heb. in my bosom}

words.text: me. {another: Heb. a stranger} {though...: or, my reins within me are consumed with earnest desire (for that day)} {within...: Heb. in my bosom}

entries.title: Job 19:28
segments: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me? {seeing...: or, and what root of matter is found in me?}

words.text: in me? {seeing...: or, and what root of matter is found in me?}

entries.title: Job 19:29
segments: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath [bringeth] the punishments of the sword, that ye may know [there is] a judgment.
